tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Mart402 product catalog: all products, prices, payment config, error codes, rate limits. Free.

tools.name: quote_parse
tools.description: Free quote for PDF parsing: page count, route (text/scan-OCR) and the exact final price, before any payment. Use the returned quote_id with parse_document (on /mcp or /mcp/docs).

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch a previously paid result for free by receipt id (every paid response carries receipt_id).

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free recorded sample response for a paid product (from real production runs, marked sample:true) - see the exact response shape before paying anything. Available: document-pipeline, enrich, extract, jp-bonus-net, jp-business-days, jp-company, jp-consumption-tax, jp-crypto-tax, jp-dependent-threshold

tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Extract a web page to clean Markdown + metadata (auto JS rendering, robots.txt respected). $0.005 fast / $0.01 rendered; cached results half price. Choose this when you need a web PAGE as clean Markdown to read yourself; to fill a schema use structured_extract, for a PDF use pdf_info then parse_docu

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Parse a PDF to structured Markdown (hallucination-guarded OCR for scanned pages, Japanese-strong). Pass url (one step: the 402 quotes the exact price for that PDF) or quote_id from quote_parse (price fixed by the quote). One of the two is required. Choose this when the input is a PDF and you want it

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: OCR one image to text with dual-engine consensus, calibrated confidence and per-segment corroboration. Japanese-strong. Flat $0.05/image. Choose this when the input is an IMAGE (photo, screenshot, receipt); for PDFs use parse_document.

tools.name: verify_invoice
tools.description: Verify extracted invoice fields: arithmetic consistency, line-item totals, JP registration number check-digit + corporate-number existence observation (official Japan NTA registry), accounting-ready JSON. $0.015/call. Choose this when you already HAVE invoice fields (from your own extraction) and on

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Company name/domain/URL to a verified profile from primary sources + GLEIF LEI and Japan NTA corporate-number registries. Per-field evidence + confidence, honest nulls; unresolved lookups never charged. $0.03/company. Choose this when you have a company NAME or DOMAIN and need a registry-grounded pr

tools.name: structured_extract
tools.description: Fill YOUR JSON schema from any URL (hybrid LLM + deterministic canonicalization). $0.03/call. Choose this when you have your OWN JSON schema to fill from any page; for company profiles use enrich_company or jp_company_profile.

tools.name: document_pipeline
tools.description: One call: PDF invoice to parse (hallucination-guarded OCR) + field extraction + arithmetic verification (+optional issuer enrich). Flat $0.05/document; inputs validated before payment. Choose this when a PDF is an invoice/receipt and you want parse + field extraction + arithmetic verification in one

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge 2-10 PDFs into one, in order. Deterministic, $0.003.

tools.name: pdf_pages
tools.description: Extract pages from a PDF by 1-based ranges (e.g. 1-3,7) into a new PDF. Deterministic, $0.002.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: PDF facts before you pay for parsing: pages, metadata, per-page text volume, scanned-or-not estimate. $0.001. Choose this first for any unknown PDF (cheapest real call); then parse_document, pdf_pages or document_pipeline.
